verdict.rationale: Convex's own documented self-hosting option runs the same open-source backend on your own servers. It works with infrastructure such as Fly.io, RDS, Neon and Postgres, so a user can control where data physically lives. However, nothing in the evidence shows region or residency selection for the managed cloud service, and self-hosting is not framed as a residency feature. Missing for 10: managed-cloud region selection, documented data-residency guarantees or compliance statements, independent corroboration of residency control.
